parts.text: Edit only the ball. IMPORTANT: keep the cream goalie mask exactly where it is on the front of the ball, same size, same holes and scratches; the mask must stay clearly visible. Make two small changes to it: 1) draw a thin dark seam line straight across the middle of the mask, through the nose bridge, continuing the seam of the ball, so the mask itself looks cut into top and bottom halves; 2) set a small round white push-button with a dark ring onto the mask, right on the nose bridge where the seam crosses. Remove the button from the side of the ball. Everything else in the image stays exactly the same.
